purpose: Negative control. The site itself is server-rendered HTML with no client-side data transport at all, so a correct elimination table here is almost entirely absent rows. It also tests the public-API gate at its hardest: two fully documented APIs sit beside a site that uses neither.

transports.note: Absent. Data is in the markup as ordinary table rows, not as a payload.

publicApis.note: Official, documented, and NOT what the site's front end calls. Wrapping it is the public-API gate failure.
Third-party search index over the same content. Same caveat.
